title: Replication data and code for: Who Disappears from Official Tourism Statistics? A Licensing Reform, Scope Breaks and the Geography of Missing Accommodation Data in Türkiye
description: Replication data and code for an article on how Türkiye's 2021–2023 accommodation licensing reform changed the coverage of official accommodation statistics. The package contains derived district-level (852 districts, 2015–2026) and province-level datasets, the Python code that produces all tables and figures, and instructions for obtaining the original sources, which are not redistributed because of their terms of use.
notes: Code is released under the MIT License (see LICENSE). Original Ministry of Culture and Tourism files are not included; see README.md.
